title: Braseleur - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Braseleur in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Absorbs Fire outright, so any Fire skill used on it heals it. Ice is the answer.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toIce
ResistsNone
AbsorbsFire
ImmuneNone

Bring Ice damage. Fire is absorbed - using it heals the target.

sections.title: How to Beat the Braseleur
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Ice is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It absorbs Fire, so that element heals it rather than hurting it.
